thread:
oliver: Heads up — noticed small but persistent invoice-preview deltas for a handful of tenants. Root cause looks like the ingest queue heartbeat drifting vs aggregator watermark.

oliver: Example: writer emits counter with watermark=2024-11-05T10:02:00Z, aggregator picks up at 10:02:45 and persists with last_seen=10:02:00 so later joins get double-counted during replay.

sasha: :eyes: do we have logs or a query to reproduce?

oliver: Yup, attached sample logs in the query: 
```
SELECT tenant_id, event_id, persisted_watermark, ingest_ts
FROM metering.persisted_counters
WHERE ingest_ts BETWEEN '2024-11-05T10:00:00Z' AND '2024-11-05T10:10:00Z'
ORDER BY ingest_ts
```

oliver: See tenant t-42: two writes within 60s window, persisted_watermark older than incoming event_ts.

maria: Is this the same as the heartbeat-miss we saw during the proxy GC last week?

ajay: Probably related — GC paused writer loop for ~30s, heartbeat kept stale in queue metadata. Aggregator uses queue.lease_ttl to decide what to merge. If ttl < actual pause, aggregator treats old messages as new.

sasha: Quick mitigation: raise lease_ttl to 90s and add a guard in aggregator to ignore events with event_ts < persisted_watermark - 1s. Risk: we might drop legitimately late events.

junior-platform: Could we instead add an idempotency key derived from (tenant,event_id) so replays dedupe at persistence layer?

ajay: Idempotency is safer long-term but larger lift. For immediate relief we should: 1) bump lease_ttl, 2) patch aggregator to check watermark monotonicity, 3) run a backfill reconcile for affected tenants.

maria: Agree. Also need console UX note so customers see a short blip explanation in invoice-preview. I'll draft copy.

oliver: Filed a small PR with TTL bump + unit tests: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/382>

sasha: I'll add a Grafana panel for "persisted_watermark_lag" and an alert at 30s median per 5m.

billing-bot: Invoice-preview re-run for t-42 completed (job id: jb_20241105_1009). Delta reduced from $12.40 -> $0.13.

maria: Nice. Action items: oliver to merge TTL PR, ajay owners for idempotency RFC, sasha adds dashboard+alert, junior-platform to draft backfill runbook, i'll draft customer message.

ajay: One more note — need to ensure canary doesn't flip TTL in prod globally. We'll rollout TTL change to canary ring 1 then 5.

oliver: Can we schedule canary today? I can do ring-1 deploy at 11:30 PST.

sasha: I'll add the rollout to the console rollout plan and include automatic rollback if alert fires.

maria: Thanks everyone. Logging thread for postmortem if deltas reappear. :thumbsup:
